Matching widget chrome is now dropped in the shared mount path before the widget body renders.

### 1. Where the comparison lives, and the matching rule

It lives once in `interactive.js`, in the registry/`ctx` layer — not in the sixteen widgets.

- **`applyWidgetHead(container, title)`** decides whether a `.widget-head` is kept, removed, or created.
- **`HRL_INTERACTIVE.mount`** calls it **before** clearing the mount node (so it can see the enclosing `.widget` chrome) and **again after** the widget mounts (so a widget-created head is subject to the same rule).
- **`ctx.widgetHead(title)`** is the same helper, for a widget that supplies its own title.

Matching rule: take both strings, **trim**, **collapse any whitespace to a single space** (`/\s+/g → ' '`), then compare **case-insensitively** (`toLowerCase()`). Empty strings never match.

Section text is read from `container.closest('.section')` (with a `parentNode` walk if `closest` is missing), then `.section-heading`, then the first `h3`. Every lookup is null-guarded and wrapped in `try/catch`, so a widget mounted outside a `.section` does not throw.

### 2. Widgets that still render a `.widget-head`

**None of the 16 widgets do, in the 25 chapter sections.** Those heads were always `section.heading`, so they now match and are removed. The intro paragraph is untouched.

A `.widget-head` still appears when:

- there is **no** enclosing `.section` / section heading (standalone mount), or
- the title from `opts.title` / `opts.heading` / `ctx.widgetHead()` **differs** from the section heading.

No curriculum widget currently passes a different title.

### 3. Heading levels inside widget bodies

Widgets already use **`p` / `p.hint`** for per-case labels (`Play 3 of 9`, `Situation 3 of 9`, `Case …`, `Move …`). They do not emit `h3`. Outline stays `h1` (app bar) → `h2` (view) → `h3` (section) → non-heading (or `h4` if a later widget adds one).

### 4. Deviation

The navy `.widget-head` is built in `learn.js` `renderInteractive`, not inside the widgets. Per the brief, `learn.js` was left alone (section `h3` stays). The mount path **removes** a head whose text matches the enclosing section heading, which is the same outcome as “do not render it.” `styles.css`, `index.html`, and data files were not changed.

I could not run a browser or `node --check` pass; this brief forbids shell access.
